- $2x+1=2x+1$

- For the third equation, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}2x+1 & =2x+3 \\ 2x+1-2x & =2x+3-2x \\ 1 & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

This equation is false for all values of $x.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II only."
